lines: Our gazes meet in a sudden moment.
You remember the thrill of good luck.
I fell in love during the pastel‑colored season.
Stay the way you shine, just like that day.
Don’t give up, just a little longer.
Run through to the very end.
No matter how far apart we are,
my heart is right beside you.
Chase the distant dream.
Whatever happens, keep that carefree smile.
I’ll act silly, saying it’ll work out somehow.
"Tonight, let’s dance together."
I still love you like that, don’t forget.
Don’t give up, look, it’s right there.
The goal is drawing near.
No matter how far apart we are,
my heart is right beside you.
Feel it, my gazing eyes.
